question: If sin A=(2)/(5), where A" id="MathJax-Element-17-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AA" id="MathJax-Element-70-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AA" id="MathJax-Element-22-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AA" id="MathJax-Element-19-Frame" role="presentation" style="position: relative;" tabindex="0">AA A A A A A is an acute angle, what is the value of frac{5 sin A+2 operatorname{cosec} A}{sqrt{21} sec A}
solution:
**Calculation:**

Sin A = 2 / 5 , Cosec A = 5 / 2

and Sec A = 5 / √21

frac{5 sin A+2 operatorname{cosec} A}{sqrt{21} sec A}

⇒ (5 × 2/5 + 2× 5/2) / √21 × 5 / √21

⇒ (2 + 5) / 5 = 7/5
